easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Doppelgang by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Thousand-Year Storm ability.
Resolve the copy of Thousand-Year Storm's ability, copying the Doppelgang spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.
